name: Spiral Wrapping Bands
summary: PE spiral wrapping bands and tubes, 6 to 25 mm OD, for abrasion protection of wire and cable insulation and hydraulic or pneumatic tubing.
intro: Spiral wrapping bands protect wire and cable insulation, and hydraulic or pneumatic tubing, from abrasion. They can be used in a gapped manner where flexibility and economy of breakouts are needed.
features: Colour: natural and grey; other colours on request
Operating temperature up to 85 deg C
Can be used in a gapped manner where flexibility and economical breakouts are required
applications: Abrasion protection of wire and cable insulation

hero.alt: Spiral wrapping bands in grey, black and natural

seo.description: PE spiral wrapping bands SW6 to SW25 for abrasion protection of wire, cable and tubing. Up to 85 deg C. Datasheet.
